name: Sharon Meieran
occupation: Founder, Fixing Multnomah County; Doctor, Portland Street Medicine

bio.statement: In her voters' pamphlet statement, Meieran lists her occupation as founder of Fixing Multnomah County and doctor with Portland Street Medicine.
bio.excerpt: Founder, Fixing Multnomah County; Doctor, Portland Street Medicine

source.publisher: Multnomah County Elections (Voters' Pamphlet, Nov 3 2026, large print)

bio.statement: Meieran's pamphlet statement lists prior service as Multnomah County Commissioner for District 1 and work as an emergency room doctor.
bio.excerpt: Multnomah County Commissioner, District 1; Emergency Room Doctor; President, Oregon College of Emergency Physicians;

source.publisher: Multnomah County Elections (Voters' Pamphlet, Nov 3 2026, large print)

bio.statement: Meieran's pamphlet statement lists a Doctor of Medicine from the UCSF School of Medicine.
bio.excerpt: UCSF School of Medicine, Doctor of Medicine; San Francisco State University, postbaccalaureate/pre-med courses;

source.publisher: Multnomah County Elections (Voters' Pamphlet, Nov 3 2026, large print)

bio.statement: Meieran's candidate filing lists past work as medical director of the Oregon Foundation for Reproductive Health.
bio.excerpt: Medical Director, Oregon Foundation for Reproductive Health

positions.statement: In her voters' pamphlet statement, Meieran says Multnomah County reacts instead of planning and spends money without specific goals.
positions.excerpt: That’s how I learned Multnomah County reacts instead of plans, spends money without specific goals, and answers to no one.

source.publisher: Multnomah County Elections (Voters' Pamphlet, Nov 3 2026, large print)

verification.note: Statement mentioned spending without specific goals, which the excerpt omitted. Extended the excerpt to the full sentence, confirmed verbatim on the pamphlet and on multco.us/file/multco_chair_sharon_meieran.

positions.statement: In her pamphlet statement, Meieran says that as a county commissioner she worked to end the county's ambulance crisis.
positions.excerpt: As County Commissioner, I used bold, honest leadership to end our ambulance crisis,

source.publisher: Multnomah County Elections (Voters' Pamphlet, Nov 3 2026, large print)

positions.statement: Her pamphlet statement says Multnomah County is the reason Oregon ranks last in the nation for mental illness.
positions.excerpt: Multnomah County is the reason Oregon ranks last in the nation for mental illness.

source.publisher: Multnomah County Elections (Voters' Pamphlet, Nov 3 2026, large print)

positions.statement: Meieran's Fixing Multnomah County site calls for the county to account for every dollar it spends.

verification.note: fix-multco.com is not the domain printed in the pamphlet (fixmultco.com, which blocks fetching) but is confirmed as Meieran's plan site by a T3 link in OPB (2026-06-09) and the site is credited to her. T2 kept.

positions.statement: Meieran's Fixing Multnomah County site calls for the county to measure what matters.

verification.note: fix-multco.com confirmed via OPB (T3) link; see p4. T2 kept.

positions.statement: OPB reported in June 2026 that Meieran has long called for systemic changes to how the county addresses behavioral health and homelessness.
positions.excerpt: systemic changes to how the county addresses behavioral health and homelessness.

positions.statement: Willamette Week reported in June 2026 that Meieran says her plan sets specific, measurable goals with money and accountability tied to outcomes.
positions.excerpt: Not generic talking points, but specific, achievable, and measurable goals, with money and accountability tied to outcomes.

positions.statement: In her voters' pamphlet statement, Meieran says the county can spend less while doing much more.
positions.excerpt: We can spend less but do so much more.

positions.statement: Meieran's pamphlet statement says she wants a social service system in which neighborhoods are safe and businesses succeed.
positions.excerpt: I want to build a social service system where neighborhoods are safe, businesses succeed

gaps: No pamphlet or campaign-site position found on taxes or the economy

verification_summary.balance_notes: All three candidates have T1 pamphlet items plus T2 campaign-site items and T3 coverage (Singleton 5 bio/8 positions, Brim-Edwards 4/8, Meieran 4/9). Coverage comparable. Meieran's T2 items come from fix-multco.com (confirmed via an OPB link); her pamphlet website fixmultco.com and filing website SharonforChair.com could not be fetched. Missed T3: Portland Mercury 2026-03-10 'Inside the race for county chair' (Singleton and Brim-Edwards, pre-dates Meieran's entry) not used.
